title: World implementation plan and finite Frontier map: scope and actual proof boundaries

reviews.classification: full world planning/static coverage review; chronology, selected alternatives and unrun behavior kept distinct
reviews.disposition:
F1: Actual full review covers all506 original lines: revisions2–23/current-applicability, WC-SCOPE/PATHS/RULES/LIFE/CLOSURE, four frontier skill IDs/DISC1-family, OF.END.01–07, GE/GX/GC/GP/SB/SBR/BG,19-row world roster, source/entry/body/region/people/RNG/dialogue contracts, macro/micro/aspect returns, INC-P1–P5/E01–E09/O01–O05, MF-GAP01–10, FNA01–17 and five-phase/review tables. Initial1–150 clipping was recovered by untruncated1–40/41–85/86–150; all subsequent ranges through506 were actually read. No linked source book, source map, runtime, JSON map, private save, old server or candidate is verified by this content review.

F2: Opening Revision23 is a dated October7 source/native/UI/compatible-build receipt with all unit/browser/gameplay/save/failure/keyboard checks explicitly unrun. Revision22 Frontier and revisions19–21/remainder/feature waves retain their own scope and proof; command/module/source-map/registry counts are not played campaigns or current installed state. Built complete does not remove implemented-unverified. Current AD43 labels runtime below floor until its selected required checks, while AD42 makes director taste optional. Old localhost/panel-queued/active-owner/dispatch/hold/test-deferral statements do not establish live handles or today's priority. Current PROJECT selects LOTM/Klein, Harry alongside and Frontier/Mistglass test beds; no new depth, app action, worker or revival follows.

F3: Preserve the substantial campaign horizon and its finite required-ID/versioned-scope discipline without treating one slice as full world coverage. Source-only31parent portions versus two proof gates,33parents/15steps/7endings, later five-row DOD and proposed19-source roster are different denominators. Pure discovery exports/19commands/four functions are bounded implementation joins, not all careers/skills. All selected alternative content versus one player's compatible outcome are distinct. Atmospheric detail, quiet talk and ordinary people need no compulsory XP/reward/fully simulated identity; a selected promise/trade/lesson/mechanical action needs its real actor/support/consequence owner.

F4: The timeline/ending analysis preserves source baseline versus played branch, occurrence/reveal/learning time, unsupported absence versus actual occupied-time pressure and real cumulative aftermath. Arc/career/institution/departure/succession/life/destruction differ; a new chapter grants no automatic years/work or repaired stock. The1520-minute combined road/Town trip cannot fit1440 before work; local1440notice/resident-funded and comparison2160/player-funded fixtures remain alternatives. Slower route, local report, earlier evidence, changed itinerary or real speed/support can matter without shrinking native geography. Old fixed-response proposal is not every future deadline. Willing funded succession transfers supported rights/methods, not cloned statistics, automatic kin claimants or a person's future consent.

F5: World laws/history/entry driver/body/scenario are separate; source research is broader than playable coverage and LOTM/COI eras do not backfill each other. The nineteen named world rows are original scoped campaign/entry possibilities, not nineteen activated worlds, complete source qualification or today's build order. Frozen source anchors versus original extensions/unknowns stay distinct; source-supported exceptional superiority, bypass and inexhaustibility remain valid. Adversary goals/means/identity/counters/aftermath avoid forced clone replacements or automatic player-level scaling; a finale may be research/service rather than boss. Canon-holding developer routes now have their later lead-life policies; this older branch-flexible authoring palette does not override them. No blanket freedom or scripted inevitability follows for ordinary lives.

F6: Retain exact organ/body/lineage/source/control/custody distinctions and separate drain/regeneration/capacity/activation/strain/support mechanics. A source-supported transfer can grant real positive execution without granting all donor ancestry/methods. Physical loot, installed support, observer knowledge, consent and passage are independent; a nonlethal win is not extraction/death. Shared architecture and source-grounded exceptions remain under actual owners; an example chain is not a mandatory staged ritual for a stronger real means. Current AD51 supersedes the two-real-features abstraction prerequisite: design a justified first shared seam, then validate/revise through materially different consumers. No universal source/physiology/clock/actor bank, new taxonomy or engine rewrite is adopted.

F7: Integration/world-bank/repository/fork/upstream audits are attributed planning/static evidence, not measured token savings or executed dependencies. FNA delivered subset and all17dispositions differ from optional remaining aliases/loot/weaknesses/cases; reviewed42visibleforks/83heads exclude invisible/deleted and separate Neko network. INC/MF packet families and named missing scene retrieval keep meaningful gaps visible without nineteen-world launch or duplicated all-book audit. External CDDA/Inform patterns, Ink cursor and rot.js remain scoped options unless later exact owners show delivery; source-public/licensed subset does not license every asset. Current ACR/GR/AR rules govern real repeated work, identity, costs, draw history and committed terms. No dependency adoption, source expansion, gameplay, worker/message, migration, deletion, commit, push or install.

reviews.reopen: Use current campaign/world/domain owner for an authorized selected consumer. Preserve finite required content and explicit behavior/source/compatibility gaps; old held/dispatch/priorities do not execute.

reviews.classification: full world planning/static coverage review; chronology, selected alternatives and unrun behavior kept distinct
reviews.disposition:
F1: Actual full review covers all161 original lines: shared native chains, every33parent row,15strand substeps,7endings,E01–E09, snapshot limits, full hash table and final root build/native/UI refinements. Initial whole-file clipping and the91-token demand/time row clipping were recovered with smaller reads, including full44–45. All rows remain attributed static readbacks; no state/command was instantiated and no native behavior/save/browser test was executed here. COVERAGE.json is linked detail and receives no implicit full-read credit.

F2: Preserve actual host→single persist→simulation job→panel/Notebook/Quests/Events/earned-People mapping as a reported integration chain, not proof the player exercised it.154authored commands=27core+53career+74field, five sources/sevenopt-inactors in346registry are snapshot counts.31implemented-unverified parent portions plus BEHAVIOR/DIRECTOR pending explains33; all15/7/9 source-mapped does not close AC01–AC11. AC12/build correspondence and f381c6503a58 supersede earlier root-build-pending wording at that identity, not the explicit unrun behavior. Current AD42 keeps director review optional and AD43 distinguishes below-floor runtime from a statically complete map.

F3: SCOPE/PLACE/PATH/ARC rows preserve explicit enrollment/absent inert state/native access and actual240/240/40 NPC legs, player Pathfinder/interrupted remaining time, physical employer stock/finite demand and lawful chosen terms. Signing a charter accepts no jobs; earned travel/contact/evidence and available funds are not supplied by a map. Same-owner escrow return is not acquisition; fees labelled sinks are not recipient wages. No calendar faucet, accidental permit or repeated survey payout. Four skill families have distinct actual field/material/cooperation readers while native XP/mastery/body/source remain separate. Local actor identity/private jobs differ from seven introduced/met contacts and last-met-place claims.

F4: All15steps preserve firsthand versus offered report, real rope/body/kit/energy alternatives, smaller safe jobs versus newly accepted exact native-zone victory, source-supported consented frame work versus monster binding, and new performed mastery versus menu review. Current source tests/alternate worlds are not claimed. The once-consumed new encounter contribution is scoped to accepted work, with later freeze/readiness/cancel-refund refinement; do not demand the spent admission receipt continuously at completion. Refusal, termination, smaller funded retry and learned partial results are actual different lifecycle states. Repeated practice need not always reveal new understanding; native XP remains under its existing owner.

F5: Seven cumulative endings preserve actual stock split/payment, buffer/workday/reserve, mature specialist, lawful exclusive sale, signed-charter withdrawal, independently equipped/funded/willing successor and actual Town arrival/retained home. They are authored content alternatives, not an assertion every same life obtains all seven. A failed/withdrawn ending is not a fabricated combat failure or implied consent. Later independent supply does not reverse a settled exclusive sale. Frozen work/common clock, unaccepted deadline pause and new-decision support differ; no broad new absence/death/age/second-prestige policy follows.

F6: E01–E09 registration, actual native facts, consumed receipts/stock, finite programs, closures, admitted disclosure, actor means and schema/native envelope remain separate proof obligations. Optional meaning/schema4/frozen jobs are a compatibility proposal/implementation record, not new tested old-save proof or universal guard backfill. Final generic-craftsman exclusion and known-response/readback are source-level corrections, not complete search/count/accessibility safety. Current PROJECT and later owners govern new work; no Frontier expansion, runtime, source acquisition, private save, worker, migration, deletion, commit or push.
